message: The 'dynamic' keyword cannot be used in the local variable '{0}' because it is not initialized. Initialize the variable in its declaration, or use 'meta.DefineLocalVariable' to declare a run-time variable without an initializer.
title: Cannot declare a local variable of type 'dynamic' without an initializer.
rationale: The title lacks an article ('declare local variable') and the message gives no way forward; meta.DefineLocalVariable(string, IType) is the supported way to declare a run-time variable without an initializer (TemplateAnnotator.VisitVariableDeclaration reports the diagnostic whenever a dynamic variable has no initializer).
